1258 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
09-09-1258 minus 324 days:  
Go back 9 days to 1258-08-31.  
Remaining 315 days: go back into 1257 (a common year).  
315 days before 1258-01-01 is 1257-02-09? Let’s check:  
From 1257-02-09 to 1258-01-01:  
1257-02-09 → 1257-12-31 = 325 days (Feb: 19, Mar: 31, Apr: 30, May: 31, Jun: 30, Jul: 31, Aug: 31, Sep: 30, Oct: 31, Nov: 30, Dec: 31 → 19+305=324? Wait, recount:  
Feb 9–28: 20 days (9 inclusive to 28 inclusive = 20 days).  
Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31 = 306 days.  
Total = 20+306 = 326 days from 1257-02-09 to 1258-01-01. That’s too many.  

Better: subtract directly:  
09-09-1258 → 09-01-1258 = 8 days into September.  
324 days total: first subtract 8 days → 09-01-1258.  
Remaining 316 days.  
Go back through 1258: Jan–Aug: 243 days (Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 = 243).  
316 – 243 = 73 days into previous year 1257.  
1257 is common year: Dec 31 → 31 days, Nov 30 → 30 days, total 61, leaves 12 days in October.  
So 1257-10-31 minus 12 days = 1257-10-19.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1257-10-19
